page: Amazon Web Services c9g.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores using the arm64 architecture, specifically the AWS Neoverse-V3 processor running at 3.3 GHz. The processor provides 64 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. It supports single-threaded execution per core with no hyperthreading.

The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 34 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

The hardware profile presents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing high-density compute resources over memory capacity and local storage. The absence of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage options. This configuration is designed for compute-bound workloads such as batch processing, distributed analytics, high-performance computing, and containerized microservices that do not require GPU acceleration or large memory footprints.
